Aria (net-arch): quick sync: we need a playbook for v2 cutover of private endpoints that minimizes doubled egress and preserves source IP for NAT customers. focusing on session stickiness and token lifecycle.
Jon (infra): agreed. Ops asks: what can we promise to customers with strict src-ip ACLs?
Aria (net-arch): we can't promise absolute continuity for indefinite flows, but we can provide a deterministic stickiness window backed by a signed "affinity token". default TTL 120s, configurable per-tenant.
Pri (onboarding): can we expose a per-tenant migration state (auto|canary|hold) and a CLI `rctl tenant migrate`? SEs need a dry-run and an immediate opt-out.
Aria (net-arch): yes. migration_state is writable via API. dry-run toggles simulate handshake logs and metrics, no DNS changes. opt-out sets state=hold and purges affinity entries.
Marco (eng-sre): metrics we need: `cp_v2_migration_attempts_total`, `cp_v2_migration_fallbacks_total`, `affinity_tokens_issued_total`, `affinity_validation_failures_total`, and a handshake latency histogram. Alert if >0.5% tenants in fallback >10m.
Nadia (product): customer doc line: "No planned downtime; short-lived sessions should be stable. Long-lived TCP connections may see transient source-IP change during cutover; contact SE for strict ACLs." Keep it simple.
Jon (infra): technical: v2 uses short-lived signed route tokens (default 6m). We'll offer two token delivery paths: relay-agent (cloud) or token-renewer binary (on-prem). token-renewer must expose `/health` and a local socket for the proxy.
Pri (onboarding): token-renewer should also support a `--simulate` mode that fakes refresh for dry-run. size target <2MB static. include clock-skew check and a clear log when refresh fails.
Aria (net-arch): affinity token format sketch: `tenant_id|route_id|issued_ts|ttl|hmac`. Edge will honor affinity if HMAC valid and token unexpired. When dual-advertising, we issue affinity tokens for existing TCP flows to pin them to the current path.
Marco (eng-sre): prefer enforcing stickiness via token validation at the edge rather than RIB-level pinning to avoid route thrash. implement a short cache and emit `affinity_cache_miss` when tokens aren't found.
Jon (infra): DNS plan: dual-push with apex TTL=45s, helper TTL=600s, duration 6-10 minutes depending on pilot size. start with pilot=3 tenants.
Pri (onboarding): CLI: `rctl tenant migrate --id TID --mode canary --pilot 3 --dry-run`. also `--opt-out` to instantly set hold. we'll script a pilot checklist.
Aria (net-arch): fallback semantics: if v2 handshake or token refresh fails N times (configurable, default 4) within 2 minutes, pin tenant to v1 for 15 minutes and emit `cp_v2_fallbacks_total`. This prevents noisy retries and gives SEs time to investigate.
Marco (eng-sre): runbook excerpt: pause rollout if fallback_rate > 0.5% sustained for 15m. rollback = set migration_state=hold + purge affinity cache + revert DNS to previous values. add an oncall play to run a token-validation probe across representative tenants.
Nadia (product): I'll draft the FAQ and migration email with the one-liner and an opt-out path for customers with tight ACLs. include a contact flow for SE-assisted cutovers.
Pri (onboarding): after token-renewer builds in staging we'll do a 3-tenant pilot next week. include logs: handshake success rate, token refresh latency, affinity validation rate.
release-bot: token-renewer build queued: v0.1 -> staging (sha: 9f8e7d)
Aria (net-arch): action items: 1) draft RFC addendum + sequence diagram (Aria) 2) token-renewer binary + staging (Pri/Jon) 3) metrics + alerts + probes (Marco) 4) customer comms + FAQ (Nadia). I'll post the addendum tomorrow for quick review. :white_check_mark:
